_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Cruise Missile (CM) Electrical Interface Control Drawing (EICD)
summary: The CM EICD is a signature-controlled drawing set detailing the cruise missile/warhead interface and associated electrical systems used to document and control changes to the nuclear system.
use_relationship:
The CM EICD is a signature-controlled drawing set detailing the cruise missile/warhead interface and associated electrical systems. CM EICD must contain information extracted from the contractor documentation in order to complete a composite drawing reflecting the basic electrical interface features. The CM EICD provides a means to document and control changes to the nuclear system throughout the life of the CM and nuclear warhead Weapon System.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparations instructions for data resulting from the work task described by the following documents: MIL-STD-1822, Nuclear Compatibility Certification of Nuclear Weapon Systems, Subsystems and Support Equipment.
(MIL-STD-1822 is available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil, and copies of the AMAC POG System Specifications are available from the AFNWC, 8601 Frost Ave SE, Building 20203, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624.)
b. This DID is related to DI-NUOR-82445, Cruise Missile Monitor and Control Final Design Approval Report (FDAR) and DI-NUOR-81409, Certification Requirements Plan (CRP).
(Copies of the DIDs are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the solicitation or contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The CM EICD shall provide detail of the electrical power and logical signal interfaces associated with the cruise missile electrical systems used to monitor and control the missile and missile-to-warhead interfaces on the cruise missile.

children.title: The CM EICD shall provide engineering data and descriptions that define:

The general system information, which shall include CM EICD introduction and index; abbreviations; acronyms; CM monitor and control and delivery system block diagrams; system definition and overview; an interface table describing warheads, training devices and test sets; and a nuclear configuration table identifying hardware and its location and access panel locations. The information shall include CM system logical signal interfaces throughout the CM system components as they relate to monitoring and controlling of logic and power signals to the nuclear warhead interface.
The physical interfaces showing wire identification, wire gauges, wire lengths, bulkhead and splice locations, and connector pin identification.
Signature blocks for responsible agency representatives.

System block diagram of the CM electrical and message processing systems with respect to the Aircraft Monitor and Control (AMAC) signals, messages, navigation data, and power provided from the aircraft and at the warhead interface.
Carriage and release power draw with respect to time.
List of nuclear warheads to be used on CM.
List of ancillary test equipment to be used with the CM and nuclear warhead.
List of training devices to be used with the CM and nuclear warhead.
List of drawings that define the nuclear warhead, ancillary test equipment, and training devices appropriate to the CM and nuclear warhead.
